source_caption:
📺 Dave (2020–2023)

Dave follows Dave Burd, a neurotic but ambitious young rapper who believes he is destined to become one of the greatest artists in hip-hop. Known professionally as Lil Dicky, Dave struggles to turn his musical dreams into reality while dealing with insecurity, complicated relationships, financial problems, and the unpredictable entertainment industry. Alongside his loyal friends and creative collaborators, he experiences hilarious situations, awkward encounters, and unexpected challenges on his journey toward fame. As his career begins taking off, Dave discovers that success comes with personal sacrifices and difficult decisions. Combining outrageous comedy, emotional storytelling, and music industry satire, the series explores ambition, friendship, fame, identity, and personal growth.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Music • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 8.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~25–35 minutes per episode • 3 seasons • 30 episodes

🎥 Creators: Dave Burd and Jeff Schaffer

🏆 Recognition: Starring rapper Lil Dicky alongside GaTa, the series received critical acclaim for its creative storytelling, comedy, emotional depth, and appearances by major music industry celebrities.

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu • FX • Disney+ (select regions) • Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV (digital purchase). Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Dave (stylized as DAVE) is an American television sitcom that premiered on FXX on March 4, 2020. It was co-created by rapper/comedian Dave Burd (known by his stage name "Lil Dicky"), who plays the titular character, and Jeff Schaffer. Kevin Hart, Greg Mottola, and Scooter Braun are producers on the series. Lil Dicky's real-life hype man, GaTa, co-stars as himself. On May 11, 2020, the series was renewed for a second season, which premiered on June 16, 2021. On February 17, 2022, FXX renewed the series for a third season, which premiered on April 5, 2023. On February 1, 2024, FX announced that there were no current plans to renew the series while Burd pursues other projects.
